text:
jen: Release window blocked — prepare-release CI step failing with git-subtree-split exit 128. seeing 'cannot create .git/refs/heads/release-2026-03.lock' in the logs.
jen: discovered during staging canary 2/3, blocking promotion.
deploy-bot: CI run https://ci.internal/runs/9876 failed: prepare-release (exit 128)
alex: hmm, that looks like a concurrent refs lock. i saw a similar one last sprint where two pipelines tried to write the same ref.
sam: can you paste the exact tail?
jen: tail below:
```
Cloning into 'repo'...
fatal: Unable to create '/srv/git/repo/.git/refs/heads/release-2026-03.lock': File exists.
fatal: cannot write refs/heads/release-2026-03
```
jen: my guess: another pipeline run is holding the lock while this one tries a subtree split/tag.
maria: are there any auto-promote runs? ops-bot, check current locks.
ops-bot: repo-locker: current locks = refs/heads/release-2026-03 held by pipeline/4767891230 (age=4m)
alex: that explains it. pipeline/4767891230 is a canary that didn't release cleanly and left the lock file behind.
sam: options: cancel other pipeline + rerun, manually remove lock on git server, or bypass prepare-release by pinning to last-good image.
maria: do not rm locks unless we know the other run is dead. prefer cancel + rerun.
jen: attempted cancel but controller reports 'step finishing' and can't cancel split.
alex: if the other run is stuck finishing it's risky. short-term safest is to pin to last-good artifact to unblock the release window.
sam: agree. pinning avoids subtree split entirely. need a quick PR to pin image hash and a small CHANGELOG entry.
maria: PM warns window ends in ~45m. pin + manual promote seems fastest.
jen: what image hash? previous green: sha256:abcd1234 from build/5421
alex: confirm smoke coverage will still run after manual promote — deploy-bot will run smoke tests even for a pinned promote.
sam: i'll open the release PR now. please review fast.
sam: PR https://git.internal/org/release/pulls/1234 — pin to sha256:abcd1234, CHANGELOG note 'hotfix: pin to last green to bypass subtree lock'
maria: approving now.
ops-bot: scheduled manual_promote job id=4771234990 to run in 10m (requested by sam)
deploy-bot: note: manual promote will skip prepare-release split but will execute smoke-test-suite.
jen: kick off the schedule. once smoke is green we go.
alex: follow-up: i'll file a task to change prepare-release to use unique namespaced refs per run to avoid lock contention (assign alex).
maria: creating incident ticket INC-2026-33 "subtree-split lock blocking promotion" to track RCA and follow-ups.
jen: action items: sam -> open PR (done), maria -> approve & trigger promote (done), alex -> follow-up task for namespaced refs, ops -> monitor job and confirm locks cleared.
sam: after promote, let's run a pipeline to verify no orphan locks remain.
maria: agreed. we'll also add an automated check that refuses overlapping split runs for same release ref.
jen: thanks team, keep thread open until promote completes. :thumbsup:
